sequence_description: JWT IdP browser flow: control JWT vs attack JWT with wrong aud to detect audience-check bypass (proof verified under wrong policy).
description:
Assertion FAILED: atk_status >= 400
Evaluation: atk_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: JWT IdP accepted a token with wrong audience (signature/issuer valid) — indicates proof was consumed under a different semantic policy than verified.

sequence_description: JWT IdP browser flow: control JWT has exp+iat; attack JWT omits exp. If accepted, broker consumed a proof without enforcing the intended expiry semantics (Verify vs Consume mismatch).
description:
Assertion FAILED: i1_attack_login_http_status >= 400
Evaluation: i1_attack_login_http_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: JWT IdP accepted a token missing exp, indicating the broker consumed a proof without enforcing the intended expiry semantics (Verify(proof) != Consume(proof)).

sequence_description: JWT IdP browser flow: control token valid vs attack token expired (exp in the past). Broker must reject expired upstream JWTs.
description:
Assertion FAILED: atk_login_http_status >= 400
Evaluation: atk_login_http_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Expired upstream JWT was accepted by JWT IdP flow (expiry not enforced) — violates freshness.

sequence_description: JWT IdP intent token replay: reuse the same idp_intent_token to retrieve the intent twice (should be one-time or at least bound to a single completion).
description:
Assertion FAILED: intent_retrieve2_status >= 400
Evaluation: intent_retrieve2_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: idp_intent_token was reusable (second retrieve succeeded) — intent token replay indicates missing one-time-use enforcement.

sequence_description: JWT IdP browser flow: reuse the exact same upstream JWT across two separate IdP intents; if accepted twice, upstream proof may be replayable beyond intended one-time SSO semantics (hardening check).
description:
Assertion FAILED: replay2_login_http_status >= 400 OR replay2_retrieve_http_status >= 400
Evaluation: (replay2_login_http_status=200 >= 400 → False) OR (replay2_retrieve_http_status=200 >= 400 → False)
Implication: Upstream JWT was accepted again for a second IdP intent (replay across intents) — if the broker intends one-time SSO proofs, this violates freshness/anti-replay

sequence_description: JWT IdP browser flow: attempt to bypass freshness by omitting exp (should be rejected). Then replay the same no-exp JWT in a second IdP intent to check if it is (incorrectly) accepted and reusable.
description:
Assertion FAILED: atk1_login_http_status >= 400
Evaluation: atk1_login_http_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: JWT IdP accepted a token missing exp, bypassing expiry enforcement (freshness violation).

sequence_description: JWT IdP browser flow: attempt to bypass freshness by omitting exp (should be rejected). Then replay the same no-exp JWT in a second IdP intent to check if it is (incorrectly) accepted and reusable.
description:
Assertion FAILED: atk2_login_http_status >= 400
Evaluation: atk2_login_http_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: JWT IdP accepted replay of a no-exp token in a second intent; missing-exp tokens become indefinitely reusable (freshness/replay violation).

sequence_description: JWT IdP browser flow: mint a JWT with a wrong aud and ensure it is rejected (prevents overbroad acceptance that could grant sessions beyond upstream intent).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_aud_attack_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_aud_attack_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: JWT IdP accepted a token with wrong aud, potentially granting sessions beyond upstream intent (authorization binding failure).

sequence_description: Token exchange: start with limited scopes (openid only), then attempt token exchange requesting expanded scopes (openid email profile) and verify the exchanged token does not exceed upstream intent.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_limited_token_status == 200
Evaluation: user_limited_token_status=400 == 200 → False
Implication: Control limited-scope login failed; cannot interpret scope-escalation behavior.

sequence_description: Config change + re-auth: toggle login policy to disallow external IdPs and registration; ensure broker enforces policy and does not mint sessions via JWT IdP after policy hardening.
description:
Assertion FAILED: policy_hardened_http_status == 200 AND post_toggle_login_http_status >= 400
Evaluation: (policy_hardened_http_status=200 == 200 → True) AND (post_toggle_login_http_status=200 >= 400 → False)
Implication: After policy hardening (allow_external_idp=false, allow_register=false), JWT IdP login was still accepted, violating BrokerPolicy bounds on effective permissions/session issuance

sequence_description: Config change + re-auth: disable external IdPs in login policy, then attempt JWT IdP login again to ensure broker policy is enforced (no sessions minted).
description:
Assertion FAILED: policy_atk_login_http_status >= 400
Evaluation: policy_atk_login_http_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: JWT IdP login succeeded even after broker policy disabled external IdPs, indicating authorization/policy binding bypass.
